device.name: ROS 2 USB camera images and calibration

facts.text: README.md documents /camera_info as the topic for camera info.
The node declares a configurable frame_id parameter with the literal default 'camera'; a deployment may set a different frame name.
The node's CameraInfo message type is sensor_msgs::msg::CameraInfo, constructed from camera_info_manager::CameraInfoManager::getCameraInfo().
The source includes sensor_msgs/msg/camera_info.hpp for the CameraInfo message.
ImageCallback takes the node clock's current time before stamping the messages.
ImageCallback assigns that timestamp and the configured frame_id value to the CameraInfo header.
The node creates an image_transport camera publisher on the relative 'image' base topic.
ImageCallback enters its publish branch only when the captured frame is non-empty and the fps interval has elapsed.
The publish call sends the image and CameraInfo pair.
The node launch file starts usb_camera_driver_node in the '/camera' namespace.
The component launch file defines NAMESPACE = '/camera' and uses it for the container.
ConvertFrameToMessage constructs sensor_msgs::msg::Image with complete bgr8 data, height, width, a false endian flag and a stride derived from the frame; non-contiguous frames are copied row by row.
ImageCallback assigns the same current node-clock stamp and configured frame id to the image and CameraInfo before publishing them.
Camera identity, image dimensions, fps and calibration file are read during node construction before VideoCapture and the timer are initialized.
The source README describes compressed images as an external image_transport republisher requiring image_transport_plugins.
